title: Who Benefits from RAG? The Role of Exposure, Utility and Attribution Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring differences in average generation accuracy (ROUGE-L) and accuracy improvements (between RAG and LLM-only settings) for queries about entities with varying popularity levels (e.g., Low, Medium-Low, Medium-High, High).

Evaluating disparities in generation accuracy and RAG accuracy improvements for queries grouped by the historical age of the topic (e.g., Pre-1900s vs. 21st century) and the publication age of the article.
Assessing generation accuracy and performance disparities across queries categorized arbitrarily by the alphabetical grouping of their titles (e.g., a-d, e-k, l-r, s-z).
